same_pair_evidence.interpretation: DTIAM proves that drug-to-target pair signal is recoverable on this protocol. BioMaster V1's failure is a model deficiency rather than protocol impossibility.

co_primary_directional_promotion_gates.micro_pair_metric: Full EQIR must exceed frozen BioMaster V1 on S3 development-fold micro AUPRC with both target-homology and drug-scaffold bootstrap lower bounds above zero.
co_primary_directional_promotion_gates.target_query_metric: Full EQIR must not materially degrade target-macro AUPRC relative to the stronger of DTIAM and BioMaster V1; a noninferiority margin must be frozen before confirmation evaluation.
co_primary_directional_promotion_gates.drug_query_metric: Full EQIR must exceed same-pair DTIAM drug-macro AUPRC on development folds and its within-drug permutation 95% upper bound; paired drug-group bootstrap lower bound versus DTIAM must be above zero before confirmation folds are read.
co_primary_directional_promotion_gates.consistency: At least 4 of 5 seeds must improve both micro AUPRC and drug-macro AUPRC relative to their corresponding frozen references.

claim_boundary: The all-fold audit is diagnostic for existing frozen models and is not used to tune EQIR. New EQIR choices remain restricted to development folds 0-2.
